role: Expression of Interest / Tell Us About You - early career civil
subject: Expression of interest: early career civil engineering and drafting, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am lodging an expression of interest through your careers Tell Us About You pathway for early career civil engineering and drafting support roles.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge and field engineer.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for office, site and regional work. I do not yet have Australian consulting employment, so mentoring on civil design and documentation is what I am looking for.

Your early career programs put graduates in front of clients with real project responsibility, which is the kind of consulting start I want.

I have attached my resume and cover letter for the EOI form. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Marc Darenz Masarate
